# CDC PLACES 2025 release: census-tract estimates (GIS-friendly wide format), 13 target states

- **Source URL(s):** Socrata dataset `yjkw-uj5s` "PLACES: Census Tract Data (GIS Friendly Format), 2025 release": https://data.cdc.gov/Health-Status/PLACES-Census-Tract-Data-GIS-Friendly-Format-2025-/yjkw-uj5s ; rows pulled per state via SODA `https://data.cdc.gov/resource/yjkw-uj5s.csv?$where=stateabbr='<ST>'&$limit=50000` ; metadata https://data.cdc.gov/api/views/yjkw-uj5s.json ; measure list built from the long-format sibling `cwsq-ngmh` (https://data.cdc.gov/resource/cwsq-ngmh.csv, GA rows grouped by measure)
- **Fetched:** 2026-10-27 ~02:50 EDT
- **Publisher update date:** yjkw-uj5s data updated 2025-12-04 (rowsUpdatedAt 1764844763); cwsq-ngmh updated 2025-12-12. 2025 release is the latest tract release in the data.cdc.gov catalog as of fetch (catalog search for "PLACES 2026" returned nothing).
- **License / terms:** Socrata metadata `license` field: "Public Domain" (licenseId `PUBLIC_DOMAIN`) for both yjkw-uj5s and cwsq-ngmh.
- **Terms URL:** https://data.cdc.gov/api/views/yjkw-uj5s.json (license field); program page https://www.cdc.gov/places
- **Attribution:** Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion, Division of Population Health. PLACES: Census Tract Data (GIS Friendly Format), 2025 release (data.cdc.gov, yjkw-uj5s), accessed 2026-10-27
- **Coverage:** Census tracts (2020 vintage GEOIDs; all geo_ids match the 2020 tract list in `../cre/`) for GA, CA, FL, LA, NC, NY, SC, TX, IL, WA, CO, PA, AZ. 40 measures, crude prevalence (%) only (tract level has no age-adjusted values; verified: GA rows in cwsq-ngmh all `datavaluetypeid=CrdPrv`). Model inputs: BRFSS 2023 (35 measures) / 2022 (5 measures), ACS 2019–2023.
- **Public repo + video safe?** Yes

## Notes

- One row per tract. `tractfips` renamed to `geo_id` (11-char string). Socrata column `mobility_crudeprev_` (trailing underscore upstream) renamed to `mobility_crudeprev`.
- Kept upstream `<measure>_crude95ci` strings and added parsed numeric `<measure>_ci_low` / `<measure>_ci_high`. Added `lon`/`lat` parsed from the `geolocation` POINT (tract internal point).
- PLACES drops tracts with no population, so counts are slightly below the full tract list (GA 2,784 of 2,796).
- **HRSN coverage (verified from the data, not the docs):** the 7 Health-Related Social Needs measures (loneliness, foodstamp, foodinsecu, housinsecu, shututility, lacktrpt, emotionspt) are entirely null for **CO, FL, PA, TX, WA**. They are present for GA, CA, LA, NC, NY, SC, IL, AZ. Nationally (FOODINSECU in cwsq-ngmh grouped by state) HRSN exists for 40 jurisdictions; missing: CO, FL, KY, OR, PA, SD, TN, TX, VT, WA, WY. So IL, LA, NY **do** have HRSN in the 2025 release.
- **PA is nearly empty:** only 5 measures are populated (dental, mammouse, colon_screen, teethlost, sleep, i.e. the 2022-BRFSS measures). All 35 measures built on 2023 BRFSS are null for PA (confirmed in cwsq-ngmh: PA has only DENTAL, SLEEP, MAMMOUSE, COLON_SCREEN, TEETHLOST).
- Small-area model estimates; CDC cautions against using them for program/policy evaluation.
- `places_2025_measures.csv` maps measure ids to full names/categories; `wide_column_prefix` is the lowercase prefix used in the wide parquet columns (`<prefix>_crudeprev`, `<prefix>_crude95ci`, `<prefix>_ci_low`, `<prefix>_ci_high`; for MOBILITY the parquet column is `mobility_crudeprev`). Its `year` column is the BRFSS year; `ga_tracts` is the GA row count per measure.
- Built by `scripts_a/build_places_cre.py` (session scratchpad), raw CSVs kept outside the kit.
